name: Splash_Water
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent 2D cartoon WATER area projectile and impact sprite for a tower-defense game. Style reference is a blue elemental orb from the game's existing assets, STYLE ONLY. Draw one round compact aqua WATER ORB whose lower outer edge has a chunky curled splash ring, small upward blue splash tips and 3 tiny droplets. Three clean cel shading tones cyan/cobalt/white, clean bold outline and simple white highlights. Square composition with complete isolated silhouette and transparent margin. No ice facets, crystals, snowflakes, fire, wind-green, labels, frame or scene. Readable as water at tiny scale, true alpha background.
